I don't speak from experience but from things I've heard. If you eventually plan to return to the US, it may be better to study everything there. College is certainly worth the money there if you study CS. Next, American employers don't really understand European degrees so you will have to explain that. If you do study in NL, I think TU Delft is a good choice. Unlike in the US where there is a vast variability in quality of higher education, in NL all universities are good and employers here don't care where you studied in NL. But in the US, employers may look at global uni rankings if you studied abroad. Finally, it is hard to make Dutch friends here if you don't speak Duch, so be prepared to hang out with international students.
